{{Top|leg}}
'''Norbet's Nest''' was a dive bar located in [[the Skids]], in the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was a meeting point and headquarters for a team of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] employees using a combination of persuasion and intimidation to recruit new employees of rival corporation [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] to work for them.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
